text:
Counting the grapes on the plate gives about 22: roughly 20 red and 2 green. They look fairly small and oval. The plate is a square side plate of about 20-22 cm across.

At roughly 4 g per grape, 22 grapes weigh about 90 g. Some of these grapes could be larger, around 5 g each, which would put the total near 100 g.

Grapes provide about 0.69 kcal per gram, so 100 g is about 69 kcal.

I'll use a mass of 100 g and an energy of 70 kcal.

{"kcal": 70, "mass_g": 100}
